summary: Backend regression suite executed against Supabase-Postgres-migrated backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 17 pytest cases pass (100%). Covered: JWT-cookie auth (login/register/me), Property CRUD with governorate/district (create, read, update, delete + ownership permissions), location-based filtering on /api/properties and /api/properties/search (case-insensitive partial match), admin stats integer counts, and IQD subscription plans + create + list.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PropertyCreate has owner_name Optional with default '' but no min-length validation. If business rule requires owner_name, tighten to non-empty string.
database.py hardcodes pool params suited for Supabase transaction pooler; statement_cache_size=0 is correctly set (asyncpg + PgBouncer). Good.

Register endpoint returns tokens via cookies but response_model=UserResponse does not include tokens in body - acceptable since cookies are set. However, /auth/logout does not clear cookies with same samesite/secure attributes explicitly - browsers may keep stale cookies in edge cases. Consider explicit delete_cookie params matching set.
seed_admin writes /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every startup - this overwrites any manual credential changes silently.
get_properties has no default ordering safety when created_at is null; unlikely because column is NOT NULL - OK.

Property model uses Text id (uuid string) while Office uses UUID column; inconsistent typing across tables. Works because agent_id is stored as text, but foreign-key referential integrity is not enforced between properties.agent_id and users.id.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed agents, offices, properties and subscriptions. Property test cases delete their own fixtures. TEST_ agents/offices/subscriptions remain in Postgres (idempotent per-run, unique via uuid suffix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://aqarati-feature.preview.emergentagent.com. Supabase Postgres transaction pooler works with asyncpg + statement_cache_size=0. Auth uses HTTP-only cookies (access_token, refresh_token). Property location filtering uses ILIKE partial match on governorate/district. Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v. /api/upload path was intentionally not tested (env-dependent Emergent object storage init may return 400 - documented as known env limitation).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration.
